articles.title: Eagles Can Hunt Baboons Nearly Seven Times Their Weight
articles.summary: Scientists in Chad found that Verreaux's eagles hunted adult baboons weighing up to 58 pounds, raising questions about whether eagles once threatened our small ancient relatives.

articles.title: Voyager 1 Reaches a Light-Day From Earth, Nearly a Decade Before Its Twin
articles.summary: Voyager 1 hits a light-day from Earth on November 18, while Voyager 2 will not get there until about 2035, thanks to different paths chosen for speed and science.

articles.title: A New Material That Lets Water Help Capture Carbon Dioxide
articles.summary: Oregon State researchers created BVR-X, a sponge-like material that keeps water and carbon dioxide apart so it can keep capturing carbon even in humid factory exhaust.
